cards.title: Voltage, not field
cards.body: Conducted emissions on the mains are the RF voltage from each line to ground, from 150 kHz to 30 MHz, through a 50 µH / 50 Ω LISN. ICES calls that network an AMN. A clean chamber plot does not retire this test.

cards.title: Two detectors
cards.body: The tables have a quasi-peak column and an average column. Both apply. If the quasi-peak reading is already under the average limit, EN 301 489-1 says you can skip the average scan, because quasi-peak will not read lower.

cards.title: Class B shape
cards.body: From 0.15 to 0.5 MHz the limits fall with the log of frequency, 66 to 56 dBµV quasi-peak and 56 to 46 dBµV average. Then 56/46 until 5 MHz, then 60/50 until 30 MHz. At a corner, use the lower number. ICES-003 Table 1 Class B matches this.

cards.title: Class A shape
cards.body: Class A is 79 dBµV quasi-peak and 66 dBµV average from 0.15 to 0.5 MHz, then 73 and 60 out to 30 MHz. Those are looser than Class B. A product marketed for the home does not get to use them.

cards.title: When the test does not apply
cards.body: A battery product with no way to run from AC skips the mains test. A charger that allows use while charging, an adaptor, or power taken through something else that is plugged in, brings the test back. If power comes through an external brick, ICES-003 measures at that brick's mains.

cards.title: The bench picture
cards.body: Bond the LISN to the reference plane and terminate unused RF ports in 50 Ω. Tabletop practice is about 40 cm from the vertical plane and about 80 cm from the LISN. Do not wind spare mains lead into a coil. Measure the noisy intended mode, on every conductor.

cards.title: A vehicle charge lead
cards.body: ICES-002 is more specific: AMN 80 cm (+20/−0) from the body, vertical drop 10 cm (+20/−0) off the body, spare cable on supports up to 15 cm and z-folded no wider than 50 cm. If you can set the charge current, use at least 80% of maximum.

cards.title: Bandwidth
cards.body: From 150 kHz to 30 MHz the CISPR bandwidth is 9 kHz. Below 150 kHz, band A is 200 Hz. A 120 kHz or 1 MHz bandwidth does not compare with these limits. Peak is a search tool. The limit columns are quasi-peak and average.

cards.title: Usual failures
cards.body: One line only. LISN floating on paint. Measuring the mains side of the network. Support laptop on the same LISN. Open 50 Ω port. Ambient that is still there with the product off. A single point over the limit fails, even if the rest of the plot is quiet.

cards.title: Do not invent the preview
cards.body: IEC 61000-6-3's preview names an AC mains table and says to test ports that exist. It does not print the numbers. CISPR 14-1's preview separates continuous noise from clicks and does not include the click-rate table. Quote §15.107, ICES, or EN 301 489-1 Table 5 instead.
